repository.working_tree: not clean; P1356-P1360 and unrelated in-flight files coexist
repository.verifier_execution: static inspection of repository files and pre-existing receipts only; no product, Cargo, test, watch, or w process was executed by this verifier

not_claimed: general functional equivalence with ratified vanilla
strong filesystem or conversational isolation between all roles
an RSS or heap upper bound

causal_correction.finding: The first contract incorrectly required --pretty false to be rejected. A ratified-vanilla probe showed bare --pretty remains Some(true) and false is left to positional parsing.
causal_correction.action: The affected preflight, shell L0, contract, manifest, oracle suite, mutant suite, static gate, seal, and shell test were regenerated before final verification.
superseded_evidence: /tmp/p1360-green-shell-invalid-final.stdout: the obsolete rejection test executed and failed
the first P1360 contract/oracle/mutant/gate/seal hash set
causal_correction.current_interpretation: The correction is a measurement-driven repair of the obligation, not a waiver for the implementation. The new M03A/M03B pair rejects both consumption as Some(false) and artificial boolean rejection.

protected_inputs.hash_check: all current digests match the revised seal

discriminatory_gate.determinism: two same-order runs and one reverse-order run preserved the classification vector

observed_design: L2 stores compile pretty as Option<bool> with bare true and explicit equals-only boolean values.
L4 resolves None to false, keeps PdfSerializationMode independent from StreamMode and PdfTags, routes pretty to SVG/HTML, and does not route it to PNG.
PDF Pretty leaves page content streams uncompressed while resource streams retain their existing compression paths.
HTML formats the already-serialized compact string with a quote-aware tag scanner and protected inline/raw contexts.
SVG reuses SvgOptions.pretty and compatibility wrappers continue with false.

build.tail: Finished dev profile; typst-shell and typst-wiring compiled

bounded_compile_probes.reported_exit: 0 for every listed candidate compile probe

pdf.witness: default/false page stream has FlateDecode; pretty page stream is clear; font and ICC streams remain Flate; compact and tagging remain independent

memory_safety.result: No unbounded or persistent process and no artifact-limit breach is evidenced. This is process/artifact containment evidence, not direct peak-memory telemetry.

limitations: All roles shared one writable workspace; allowlists and declarations were procedural, not enforced sandboxes.
A test-author draft was started before the first seal and removed; this breaks a strict claim of pristine causal isolation.
The PDF builder A/B test was revised after its first RED, reducing independence from implementation feedback.
The initial shell filters matched zero tests, and the first corrected rejection test exposed a wrong obligation; only the regenerated contract, seal, test, and reseal receipts are credited.

The three infra receipts predate a later mechanically equivalent HTML slice rewrite to raw.get; the coordinator reports exact HTML revalidation, but a distinct preserved receipt for that rerun is not present.
No broad suite was run by design to avoid the known watch-test memory hazard.
The static mutation gate demonstrates discriminatory power of the contract model, not execution of 36 mutations against productive code.
decision: The revised protected chain is internally pinned, the static contract gate scores 1.0, five focused tests have one-test/one-pass receipts, architecture lint and bounded compile probes pass, and the requested memory containment was observed. P1360 therefore passes only for its recorded fragment and with limited attestation.
